value.rationale: The exact infinite-rank antidictionary of the classical unavoidable-pattern family is mathematically natural and structurally interpretable: its forbidden words have only exponentially separated lengths and a cubic, not exponential, output-size law relative to rank. A complete language description gives symbolic compression and provides a benchmark for absent-word algorithms, beyond routine finite enumeration.
